summary: Configured node1 successfully. HAProxy serves HTTP on port 80 and proxies to the Node.js application bound only to 127.0.0.1:3000. The endpoint returns HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs`, including after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the loopback-only Node.js application under a dedicated system account.
Created and enabled `infraset-nodejs.service` with automatic restart behavior.
Configured and enabled HAProxy on port 80 with the backend at 127.0.0.1:3000.
Validated the HAProxy configuration and endpoint behavior.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified service persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves `/` on port 80 and returns HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs` while Node.js listens only on loopback port 3000.
evidence.summary: Post-restart checks show HAProxy owning port 80, Node.js owning only 127.0.0.1:3000, port 3000 unavailable through the node IP, valid HAProxy configuration, and the exact required HTTP response.
Shows the named unit enabled, active and running, with `/usr/bin/nodejs /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js` as its managed process.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery evidence for node1.
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered enabled services, listeners, HTTP 200 response, exact body, and loopback-only backend after restart.
